brand_strategy.positioning: The professional network where respected independents build meaningful careers with quality-focused brands
brand_strategy.brand_promise: Fair partnership: Your expertise deserves to be valued at full price

white_space_opportunities.opportunity: Premium positioning for freelancers, not just for clients
white_space_opportunities.customer_need: Freelancers want to be respected, well-paid, and valued for expertise
Experienced freelancers want career stability, not constant client hunting

brand_voice_references: Paul Graham's essays on startups (thoughtful, clear, direct)
design_constraints: B2B context but user-facing (needs warmth without cuteness)
Must work at small scales (favicon, app icon)
Must appeal to both freelancers and brands (avoid gender coding)
